interpretation: The 30-parameter equation has real same-chart held-spatial-block capacity and beats both the affine and shuffled-correspondence controls, but it achieves that gain with material range escape and local orientation reversal while absolute error remains high. The failure is therefore structural and accuracy-limited, not evidence that the chart contains no recoverable mapping.
